cases.name: light load: one call's entry is sent byte for byte as it was stored
under load: four waiting calls become one body, each event with its own key
merged events are the stored events, field for field
an MCP call's events keep their per-tool keys and their order
put-back events carry their count; the count never reaches the ingestor
a put-back entry on its own is rewritten without its count
an entry that is not JSON adds nothing
ten put-back entries of 50 make one body of 500
